# mistershell_command (Resource)

Manages a MisterShell command.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mistershell_command" "example" {
  name          = "show-platform-version"
  resource_type = "cisco_ios"
  description   = "Read device version."
  category      = "Inventory"
  mode          = "read"
  definition    = { command = "show version" }
  parse_source  = { kind = "no_parse" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `category` (String) Category.
- `definition` (Dynamic) Definition. Accepts a native Terraform value.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `mode` (String) Mode.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `parse_source` (Dynamic) Parse source. Accepts a native Terraform value.
- `resource_type` (String) Resource type.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enabled.
- `parameter_schema` (Dynamic) Parameter schema. Accepts a native Terraform value.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Created at.
- `executor` (String) Executor.
- `id` (String) Object identity. Import using this ID; resource variables use resource_id:stack_id.
- `is_builtin` (Boolean) Is builtin.
- `is_editable_definition` (Boolean) Is editable definition.
- `updated_at` (String) Updated at.

## Ownership and lifecycle

This resource manages custom commands. Built-in commands are available through the data source and cannot be imported as managed resources, because the API does not allow their deletion.

## Import

```shell
terraform import mistershell_command.example 123
```
